title: JWT Authentication

searches.query: "JWT Authentication" interview audience key rotation revocation
searches.result: success; exact-concept search executed, but independent frequency/rank/company evidence was insufficient; prompts are original production adaptations and technical decisions use checked primary sources

sources.title: System Design Primer: Security
sources.supportRationale: Core conceptual orientation checked during specification; its brief section explicitly needs updates and is not the sole protocol/crypto authority or evidence of interview frequency.

sources.title: IETF RFC 8725: JSON Web Token Best Current Practices
sources.supportRationale: Algorithm verification, trusted keys, issuer/audience and distinct JWT usage profiles; not a universal authorization or revocation protocol.

sources.title: OWASP: Authorization Cheat Sheet
sources.supportRationale: Least privilege, default denial and resource/action authorization on every request, with trusted enforcement and failure handling.

sources.title: OpenID Connect Core 1.0 incorporating errata set 2
sources.supportRationale: Identity layer, ID Token and flow-specific issuer/audience/nonce validation; logout/discovery details need their own verified extension contract if used.

sources.title: OWASP: REST Security Cheat Sheet
sources.supportRationale: API credentials, token/access controls, safe error/log handling and TLS; API keys alone are insufficient for every sensitive resource.

sources.title: IETF RFC 9700: OAuth 2.0 Security Best Current Practice
sources.supportRationale: Modern OAuth threat model, redirects, PKCE, client-specific refresh-token replay protection and scoped revocation concerns.

sources.title: OWASP: Session Management Cheat Sheet
sources.supportRationale: Opaque session lifecycle, cookie scope, regeneration, expiry and server-side invalidation; flags do not replace authorization/CSRF controls.

sources.title: IETF RFC 10017: OAuth 2.0 for Browser-Based Applications
sources.supportRationale: Browser OAuth threats and architectural boundaries including BFFs, checked as the published August 2026 BCP rather than an old draft.

sources.title: OWASP: Cross Site Scripting Prevention Cheat Sheet
sources.supportRationale: Context-specific encoding, safe sinks, maintained rich-HTML sanitization and CSP defense in depth.

sources.title: OWASP: Cross-Site Request Forgery Prevention Cheat Sheet
sources.supportRationale: Framework token protection, signed/session-bound double submit, origin and SameSite defense boundaries; CORS is not universal CSRF protection.
